subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 the canonical remaining prevention tracker now that the recovery-carrier fixes landed?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider replay semantics and has multiple open candidate PRs, so automation should not decide the durable Anthropic thinking policy by opening another fix branch.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue later as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to the focused remaining issue and PR path.

options.title: Defer Prevention
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as sufficient for now and defer replay-policy prevention to a later provider review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent Anthropic/provider-area history and is already in the issue discussion around the landed recovery half.
